trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 (the latest deploy), which was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Restored checkout-api to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version that was healthy in production, across all regions. The rollback was verified as successfully rolled out.
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged.
